mapper.insert: INSERT INTO case_result (id, case_code, title, unit, coordinate_system, manifest_version, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{caseCode}, #{title}, #{unit}, #{coordinateSystem}, #{manifestVersion}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, case_code, title, unit, coordinate_system, manifest_version, status, created_at, updated_at FROM case_result WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
